statement: The date the United Klans of America conveyed its Tuscaloosa headquarters to Beulah Mae Donald is not established here.
owed: The conveyance date from a primary record. One secondary source dates it to May 1986, which precedes the February 1987 verdict and cannot be right as stated.
note: Recorded rather than resolved by preferring whichever source read better. Nothing in the corpus rests on this date; the verdict, the theory and the outcome are sourced separately and are unaffected.
